parameters.query:
SELECT
  -- ===== 1) ข้อมูลจาก Excel (excel_purchase_tax) =====
  e.invoice_number    AS excel_invoice_number,
  e.date_raw          AS excel_date_raw,
  e.doc_title         AS excel_doc_title, 
  e.vendor_name       AS excel_vendor_name,
  e.vendor_vat_id     AS excel_vendor_vat_id,
  e.vendor_branch     AS excel_vendor_branch,
  e.net_amount        AS excel_net_amount,
  e.vat_amount        AS excel_vat_amount,
  e.grand_total       AS excel_grand_total,
  NULL::text          AS excel_name,

  -- ===== 2) ข้อมูลจาก invoices (PDF) =====
  i.id                AS pdf_id,
  i.invoice_number    AS pdf_invoice_number,
  i.date_raw          AS pdf_date_raw,
  i.doc_title         AS pdf_doc_title,
  i.vendor_name       AS pdf_vendor_name,
  i.vendor_vat_id     AS pdf_vendor_vat_id,
  i.vendor_branch     AS pdf_vendor_branch,
  i.net_amount        AS pdf_net_amount,
  i.vat_amount        AS pdf_vat_amount,
  i.grand_total       AS pdf_grand_total,
  i.name              AS pdf_name,
  i.path              AS pdf_path,
  i.created_at        AS pdf_created_at,

  -- ===== 3) ข้อมูลจาก invoice_check_summary =====
  s.id                        AS summary_id,
  s.invoice_id                AS summary_invoice_id,
  s.invoice_number            AS summary_invoice_number,
  s.vendor_vat_id             AS summary_vendor_vat_id,
  s.vendor_branch             AS summary_vendor_branch,
  s.invoice_status,
  s.buyer_vat_info_status,
  s.invoice_number_status,
  s.date_raw_status,
  s.vendor_name_status,
  s.vendor_vat_id_status,
  s.vendor_vat_id_info_status,
  s.vendor_branch_status,
  s.net_amount_status,
  s.vat_amount_status,
  s.grand_total_status,
  s.missing_in_pdf,
  s.missing_in_excel,
  s.all_ok,
  s.updated_at                AS summary_updated_at

FROM {{ $json.body.schema }}.excel_purchase_tax e
FULL OUTER JOIN {{ $json.body.schema }}.invoices i
  ON  i.invoice_number = e.invoice_number
  AND i.vendor_vat_id  = e.vendor_vat_id
  AND i.vendor_branch  = e.vendor_branch
  
LEFT JOIN {{ $json.body.schema }}.invoice_check_summary s
  ON  s.invoice_number = COALESCE(e.invoice_number, i.invoice_number)
  AND s.vendor_vat_id  = COALESCE(e.vendor_vat_id,  i.vendor_vat_id)
  AND s.vendor_branch  = COALESCE(e.vendor_branch,  i.vendor_branch)

ORDER BY
  COALESCE(e.invoice_number, i.invoice_number);
